      • 13 Things I'll Miss About You

        13 Things I'll Miss About You

        By Community_Member_20 · Saturday at 11:55 AM4 days

        Yesterday was the worst day of my life: I lost my Maltipoo, Lexie, so I wrote this for her 💔 Thirteen Things I'll Miss About You

        1: your fluffy tail and how you waved it around proudly like a plume

        2: the way you tilt your head when I make a funny noise

        3: How excited you get when I come home no matter how short of a time I was away for

        4: When you poked your cute muzzle through the bars of your crate and stared at me

        5 Your goofy, silly personality when you play

        6 your little brown nose that had a freckle on it which matched mine, and how you wiggled it when you were curious

        7 the way you snuggled up into my neck when I held you

        8 Your sassy bark and the impatient way you pawed at me if I didn't pet you

        9: How you always snuggled with me during school, video games, or movies

        10 The way you run to me when you're scared or needed love

        11 The way you loved to climb over across my shoulders like a lamb and just lay there

        12: the little things like bathing you, taking you outside morning and night, and feeding you your favorite bone

        13: and most of all, your dark brown eyes that always looked at me with such a soft look

        I miss you, Lexie 😞

        Community_Member_20

          Search

          Search

          Configure browser push notifications
          Chrome (Android)
          1. Tap the lock icon next to the address bar.
          2. Tap Permissions → Notifications.
          3. Adjust your preference.
          Chrome (Desktop)
          1. Click the padlock icon in the address bar.
          2. Select Site settings.
          3. Find Notifications and adjust your preference.
          Safari (iOS 16.4+)
          1. Ensure the site is installed via Add to Home Screen.
          2. Open Settings App → Notifications.
          3. Find your app name and adjust your preference.
          Safari (macOS)
          1. Go to Safari → Preferences.
          2. Click the Websites tab.
          3. Select Notifications in the sidebar.
          4. Find this website and adjust your preference.
          Edge (Android)
          1. Tap the lock icon next to the address bar.
          2. Tap Permissions.
          3. Find Notifications and adjust your preference.
          Edge (Desktop)
          1. Click the padlock icon in the address bar.
          2. Click Permissions for this site.
          3. Find Notifications and adjust your preference.
          Firefox (Android)
          1. Go to Settings → Site permissions.
          2. Tap Notifications.
          3. Find this site in the list and adjust your preference.
          Firefox (Desktop)
          1. Open Firefox Settings.
          2. Search for Notifications.
          3. Find this site in the list and adjust your preference.
